verdict.rationale: The API/CLI/MCP surface covers core search, chat, embeddings, and even browser automation via the Computer MCP server, giving strong parity for search-and-answer workflows. However, several flagship UI features (Assistant's email drafting/scheduling/booking, Discover feed, Library curation, Voice mode, Labs reports) are not documented as accessible through the API/CLI, so parity is incomplete. Missing for 10: API/CLI equivalents for Assistant task automation, Discover, Library, Voice, and Labs report generation, plus independent confirmation these UI-only features can't be reached programmatically.
